vi: Chọn đúng data store: Cloud SQL HA + read replica cho startup OLTP <10k QPS, Spanner chỉ khi cần external strong consistency xuyên region.
Thiết kế Cloud SQL HA (REGIONAL availability_type) với primary + standby sync qua regional disk, và read replica async để scale đọc.
Áp dụng two-layer deletion_protection (provider-level + settings.backup_configuration) để chống xoá accidental.
So sánh cost realism: Spanner gấp 100 lần Cloud SQL nhưng đặc thù TrueTime + atomic clock cho consistency bên ngoài transaction.
Force failover Cloud SQL offline để test recovery, hiểu standby auto-promote mà không chờ sự cố thật.
en: Choose the right data store: Cloud SQL HA + read replicas for startup OLTP <10k QPS, Spanner only when needing external strong consistency across regions.
Design Cloud SQL HA (REGIONAL availability_type) with primary + standby syncing via regional disk, plus async read replica to scale reads.
Apply two-layer deletion_protection (provider-level + settings.backup_configuration) to prevent accidental deletion.
Compare cost realism: Spanner costs 100x more than Cloud SQL but uses TrueTime + atomic clocks for consistency beyond transactions.
Force-failover Cloud SQL offline to test recovery, understanding how standbys auto-promote without waiting for real outages.
